key_highlights: ASX rallied to notch a third consecutive week of gains, driven by resource and technology shares.
Australian unemployment surged to a five-year high, abruptly tempering RBA rate hike expectations.
The Australian dollar dropped sharply following the weaker labour market print.
Sydney auction clearance and housing markets face severe downside pressures, raising credit risk.
Global macro concerns mount over 'China Shock 2.0' and domestic gas market deficits.

sectors.trend: Strong rally in resource equities backed by gold exploration momentum and critical minerals production schedules.
sectors.implications: Earnings momentum remains resilient for gold and base metals, but external China demand risks remain an overhang for iron ore majors.

sectors.trend: Dovish RBA repricing following rising joblessness clashes with worsening housing auction distress.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin expansion has peaked; loan impairment risks and slowing mortgage credit growth threaten bank valuations.

sectors.trend: Strong weekly advance tracking lower sovereign bond yields and receding rate hike odds.
sectors.implications: Multiple expansion supports growth valuations, offering short-term outperformance.

sectors.trend: Severe structural supply constraints and policy pressures impacting the domestic gas market.
sectors.implications: Elevated domestic spot gas prices support uncontracted upstream producers while squeezing industrial end-users.

sectors.trend: Accelerating correction in metropolitan residential auctions and softening secondary transactions.
sectors.implications: Residential developers face demand headwinds and margin compression, while commercial REITs gain modest yield relief.

key_themes: Deteriorating labour market extinguishing RBA cash rate hike risks
ASX materials and tech sectors driving index momentum despite macro headwinds
AUD depreciation driven by weaker domestic employment data
Sharp downturn in Sydney residential auction and property market sentiment
Emerging 'China Shock 2.0' posing external trade and commodity demand uncertainty

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to consumer discretionary and cyclical banking; tilt toward defensive healthcare and staples.
Underweight high-LTV domestic mortgage lenders and pure-play residential developers.
Diversify resource exposure from bulk iron ore into precious metals and critical minerals.
Hold upstream producers with flexible domestic supply contracts to capture spot price spikes.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate gold producers and near-term critical minerals developers
opportunities.rationale: Resource momentum and active project fast-tracking provide strong earnings visibility amid geopolitical uncertainty.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long positions in quality ASX technology
opportunities.rationale: Eased RBA rate hike expectations lower discount rates, benefiting high-growth tech firms.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective overweight in upstream domestic gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Acute gas supply tightness reinforces high domestic realized pricing.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to high-multiple domestic banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated unemployment and Sydney property distress elevate loan loss provisioning and crimp credit growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement downside protection on broad Australian equities
defensive_moves.rationale: The divergence between index gains and underlying macroeconomic deterioration increases correction vulnerability.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) will likely consolidate gains over the next 1–3 months as resource sector resilience is offset by softer consumer fundamentals and AUD weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Over 6–12 months, persistent labour market cooling should transition RBA policy toward rate cuts, eventually stabilizing credit conditions and supporting equities.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and revised cash rate guidance
Upcoming Australian quarterly CPI and wages price index releases
China policy responses to export overcapacity and international trade disputes
Major bank credit loss provisioning disclosures and mortgage delinquency rates
watch_list: Australian unemployment rate and underemployment metrics
Sydney and Melbourne auction clearance rates
Gold spot and iron ore CFR Qingdao pricing
